definitions: paper_date = arXiv v1 submission date of the headline cosmology paper (from the arXiv API 'published' field). data_start/data_end = observing dates as stated by the release's own papers (or its data-release paper where noted). Month or year precision where the source gives only that. survey_start for ACT and SPT is first light, not first science night. Planck area 41253 deg2 (full sky) and ACT DR6 10300 deg2 (25% of sky) are computed, not quoted. A release may carry an also list of companion key papers.

surveys.name: DES

survey_start.quote: DES began searching the Southern skies on August 31, 2013.

survey_end.quote: DES was allocated 760 distinct full- or half-nights of observations between 2013 August 15 and 2019 January 9

surveys.notes: Science Verification ran 2012 November 1 through 2013 February 22 (DES DR1, arXiv:1801.03181: 'Science Verification (SV) period (2012 November 1 through 2013 February 22)'). DR1 and the Y3/Y6 key papers count the wide survey from 2013 August 15 ('345 distinct nights ... from 2013 August 15 to 2016 February 12', arXiv:1801.03181), while the Y1 papers and the DES website give August 31, 2013; survey_start uses the website date.

surveys.name: KiDS

survey_start.quote: all tiles observed in all four filters during the first year of regular operations (15 October 2011 to 31 September 2012), including data taken during Early Science Time (EST, 13 August to 15 October 2011)

survey_end.quote: The ESO-KiDS public survey completed observations in July 2019, spanning 1350 deg2

surveys.notes: Early Science Time ran 13 August to 15 October 2011 (de Jong et al. 2015, arXiv:1507.00742); the DR3/DR5 data (and so the lensing releases) include it, so data_start is August 2011. The DR5 paper (arXiv:2503.19439) mentions observations 'In November 2020, towards the end of the survey data taking', so some KiDS observing (the second i-band pass) seems to extend past the July 2019 completion date quoted by Heymans et al. 2021.

Heymans et al. 2021 say KiDS 'completed observations in July 2019'; the DR5 paper describes observing in November 2020 'towards the end of the survey data taking', affecting mostly the second i-band pass of the KiDZ calibration fields, so the wide lensing data most likely end in 2019 (not confirmed to the month). Effective area 967.4 deg2 of a 1347 deg2 footprint. Companion (Stölzner et al., 2503.19442) same day; DR5 data paper (Wright et al., 2503.19439) also same day.

surveys.name: Planck

survey_start.quote: Routine operations and science observations began 12 August 2009.

survey_end.quote: It scanned the microwave and submillimetre sky continuously between 12 August 2009 and 23 October 2013

surveys.notes: Launched 14 May 2009 ('was launched 14 May 2009', arXiv:1303.5062). HFI cryogenic phase ended 14 Jan 2012 ('14 Jan 2012 . . . . End of cryogenic mission, start of warm phase', arXiv:1807.06205 Table 1); after that only LFI observed, so the 2015 and 2018 temperature/polarisation cosmology is dominated by data up to Jan 2012. Lensing papers (2013 XVII 1303.5077, 2015 XV 1502.01591, 2018 VIII 1807.06210) were submitted the same day as each parameters paper.
